cases.step_name: Whole flow
cases.title: Signed out while in the flow
cases.question: After signing in again, do they return to where they were?
cases.expected: If the desktop ATS SSO session or Telegram auth expires mid-apply, pause and prompt re-auth in ShadowMux/Telegram without losing the tailored PDF or form state.

cases.step_name: Previews single-page LaTeX PDF in Telegram
cases.title: The other system returns an error
cases.question: Is the message specific, and is there a retry or another route?
cases.expected: If Tectonic is missing or LaTeX compilation fails (compiler.py currently returns .tex path), surface a clear error and never send raw .tex as a PDF preview.

cases.step_name: Acquires ShadowMux desktop lease & cookies
cases.title: No connection
cases.question: What does the user see offline, and is their work kept until they are back?
cases.expected: If the user taps 1-Tap Apply on mobile while desktop ShadowMux is asleep or offline, queue the job and notify the user when the desktop worker picks it up.

cases.step_name: Acquires ShadowMux desktop lease & cookies
cases.title: The other system returns an error
cases.question: Is the message specific, and is there a retry or another route?
cases.expected: If ShadowMux daemon crashes or Chrome fails to spawn at (-3200,-3200), release any partial lock and notify Telegram with a manual apply link.

cases.step_name: Acquires ShadowMux desktop lease & cookies
cases.title: Half of it worked
cases.question: If only part succeeded, what state is the user left in and how do they finish?
cases.expected: If SQLite lease is acquired but cookie mirroring fails, release the lease immediately so the domain is not locked for 120s TTL.

cases.step_name: Off-screen browser fills ATS form & uploads PDF
cases.title: No connection
cases.question: What does the user see offline, and is their work kept until they are back?
cases.expected: If network drops mid-autofill, abort before Submit, release the ShadowMux lease, and offer a retry without risking partial form submission.

cases.step_name: Off-screen browser fills ATS form & uploads PDF
cases.title: The other system returns an error
cases.question: Is the message specific, and is there a retry or another route?
cases.expected: If the ATS returns 4xx/5xx or rejects the PDF upload format/size, capture the error banner screenshot and notify Telegram.

cases.step_name: Off-screen browser fills ATS form & uploads PDF
cases.title: Button pressed twice
cases.question: Can a double press create two records, charges or messages?
cases.expected: Check the local applications ledger (UNIQUE job_id) and disable the Telegram 1-Tap Apply button immediately after first confirmation.

cases.step_name: Off-screen browser fills ATS form & uploads PDF
cases.title: Half of it worked
cases.question: If only part succeeded, what state is the user left in and how do they finish?
cases.expected: If fields fill but file upload fails, escalate to HITL with the partial form intact rather than submitting without a resume.

cases.step_name: Off-screen browser fills ATS form & uploads PDF
cases.title: Data changed since the screen loaded
cases.question: If price, stock, permissions or status changed meanwhile, who wins?
cases.expected: Verify the requisition is still open (not 404/closed) before filling; if closed overnight, mark expired and surface tomorrow's #2 role.

cases.step_name: Submits form, captures screenshot & stamps SQLite audit
cases.title: No connection
cases.question: What does the user see offline, and is their work kept until they are back?
cases.expected: Never blindly retry Submit after a network drop; check ATS confirmation email/page state first or escalate to human verification.

cases.step_name: Submits form, captures screenshot & stamps SQLite audit
cases.title: No answer in time
cases.question: After how long does it give up, and what can the user do then?
cases.expected: After clicking Submit, poll up to 30s for confirmation; on timeout, save a screenshot and mark status='uncertain_needs_check' instead of failing.

cases.step_name: Submits form, captures screenshot & stamps SQLite audit
cases.title: The other system returns an error
cases.question: Is the message specific, and is there a retry or another route?
cases.expected: Parse inline ATS validation errors (e.g. invalid phone format) and route to HITL instead of generic failure.

cases.step_name: Submits form, captures screenshot & stamps SQLite audit
cases.title: Half of it worked
cases.question: If only part succeeded, what state is the user left in and how do they finish?
cases.expected: If ATS accepted the submission but local SQLite write or screenshot failed, still record the confirmation code from browser DOM and retry DB write.

cases.step_name: Solves CAPTCHA or custom question via Telegram link
cases.title: Typed data lost on error or navigation
cases.question: If the step fails or the user steps back, is what they typed kept?
cases.expected: If the 180s HITL window expires or the mobile webview reloads, persist any typed custom essay answers locally and allow resuming.

cases.step_name: Solves CAPTCHA or custom question via Telegram link
cases.title: 180-second HITL timer expires before user finishes
cases.question: What happens to the detached browser tab, lease, and typed answers when the 180s timeout fires?
cases.expected: Save typed answers, release the ShadowMux lease cleanly, and send a 'Resume on desktop' option instead of silently dropping.

cases.step_name: Off-screen browser fills ATS form & uploads PDF
cases.title: ATS sponsorship / visa question does not match boolean preset
cases.question: How are nuanced multi-option work authorization dropdowns mapped when preset is a single string?
cases.expected: Escalate ambiguous visa/sponsorship dropdowns to HITL instead of guessing a legally binding answer.

cases.step_name: Previews single-page LaTeX PDF in Telegram
cases.title: Tectonic/pdflatex binary missing on host

cases.expected: Fail fast at setup/lint or ship bundled Tectonic binary; never attach a .tex file as a resume upload to an ATS.

cases.step_name: Previews single-page LaTeX PDF in Telegram
cases.title: No connection
cases.question: What does the user see offline, and is their work kept until they are back?
cases.expected: Pre-compiled PDFs cached locally at 08:58 AM should queue cleanly in Telegram and deliver when connectivity returns; show a clear offline status if requested on demand.

cases.step_name: Previews single-page LaTeX PDF in Telegram
cases.title: Half of it worked
cases.question: If only part succeeded, what state is the user left in and how do they finish?
cases.expected: If PDF renders but fails pdftotext containment or >1-page overflow check after pruning, block preview and alert the user instead of sending a broken PDF.

cases.step_name: Previews single-page LaTeX PDF in Telegram
cases.title: Data changed since the screen loaded
cases.question: If price, stock, permissions or status changed meanwhile, who wins?
cases.expected: If the user edits master_bullets after 08:58 AM pre-compilation, invalidate the cached PDF before sending Preview.

cases.step_name: Acquires ShadowMux desktop lease & cookies
cases.title: Data changed since the screen loaded
cases.question: If price, stock, permissions or status changed meanwhile, who wins?

cases.step_name: Reads daily Telegram match card

cases.expected: Add an 'Already applied' action distinct from 'Skip' so preference weights are not distorted.
